title: PGI — Arcade & Film Room
recording: Three original arcade favorites and three original orchestral postgame themes.

tracks.title: Saturday Voltage
tracks.description: Driving arena-rock backbeats, a bright guitar hook and a climbing solo answer.
tracks.provenance: Original PGI composition and procedural recording. No third-party recordings, samples, lyrics, or copied riffs.

tracks.title: Fourth and Thunder
tracks.description: Driving minor-key gallops, a rising twin-guitar refrain and a half-time siege.
tracks.provenance: Original PGI composition and procedural recording. No third-party recordings, samples, lyrics, or copied riffs.

tracks.title: Neon End Zone
tracks.description: Swaggering blues-metal riffs, cowbell accents and an open major-key chorus.
tracks.provenance: Original PGI composition and procedural recording. No third-party recordings, samples, lyrics, or copied riffs.

tracks.title: Sunday in Gold
tracks.description: A brass-led processional, field snare, and a full-string return.
tracks.provenance: Original PGI composition. GeneralUser GS instrument samples by S. Christian Collins; TinySoundFont rendering. No NFL Films recording or melody.

tracks.title: Leather and Thunder
tracks.description: Minor-key brass, urgent pizzicato strings, timpani, and a woodwind interlude.
tracks.provenance: Original PGI composition. GeneralUser GS instrument samples by S. Christian Collins; TinySoundFont rendering. No NFL Films recording or melody.

tracks.title: The Long Walk Home
tracks.description: Warm horns, lyrical strings, harp, and a measured closing cadence.
tracks.provenance: Original PGI composition. GeneralUser GS instrument samples by S. Christian Collins; TinySoundFont rendering. No NFL Films recording or melody.
